cohort: All women who delivered infants between 1998 and 2007 at Massachusetts General Hospital, divided into a group with previous r-AKI without history of CKD (n=105) and a control group without kidney disease (n=24,640).
finding: A past episode of acute kidney injury, despite return to normal renal function before pregnancy, was associated with increased risk for preeclampsia and adverse fetal outcomes in subsequent pregnancies.
gest_age: 37.6 ± 3.6 weeks for infants of women with r-AKI and 39.2 ± 2.2 weeks for infants of controls.
